Class CellposeSegmentationParams

java.lang.Object
qupath.ext.biop.cellpose.backend.CellposeSegmentationParams
public final class CellposeSegmentationParams extends Object
Immutable value object describing the Cellpose parameters the ApposeBackend needs, decoupled from the CellposeBuilder/Cellpose2D internals. It carries only the subset of Cellpose options the in-process transport supports.
